L2t: Leonora Neuffer Bilger was an American chemist who taught at the University of Pennsylvania and was recognized for her contributions to chemistry.
L3t: The Garvan Medal, established in 1936 by the American Chemical Society, honored Bilger as an early woman recipient, and she received it in the early 1950s, in the same year she was recognized as the 18th recipient.
L4t: Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953.
